messages:
alice: Quick sync — ran a GPTQ slicewalk across Llama-3-8B, Mistral-8x, and Qwen-7B. Focus: instruction-following, MMLU, long-context QA, and KV-cache drift.
ben: Nice. Which quant configs did you try?
alice: GPTQ-4bit (per-channel), AWQ-4bit, int8 dynamic, and FP8 (experimental). Also one hybrid: GPTQ weights + AWQ attention.
carla: Did you keep activation folding on for Mistral? We saw differences before.
alice: Yes — activation folding ON for Mistral runs. For Llama and Qwen it was default (off) because of kernel incompatibilities.
eva: What about eval prompt sets? short-instr, long-instr, multi-hop QA (Hotpot-style), and a 512->32k long context summarization probe.
frank: Any surprising deltas? numbers?
alice: TL;DR: GPTQ-4bit holds up best on instruction-following across families (~1–2 pt drop on MMLU vs fp16 baseline). AWQ shows lower latency but has a ~3–6pt delta on multi-hop QA on Qwen and Mistral. FP8 is mixed: great for throughput on some sequences but unstable on longer KV chains (seen context collapse at >8k).
ben: Can you paste the MMLU summary table?
alice: ```
MMLU (baseline fp16 = 100):
Llama-3-8B: GPTQ-4b=98, AWQ-4b=95, int8=97, FP8=99
Mistral-8x: GPTQ-4b=97, AWQ-4b=92, int8=96, FP8=98
Qwen-7B: GPTQ-4b=96, AWQ-4b=90, int8=95, FP8=97
```
carla: Interesting that FP8 is near baseline for MMLU. How about instruction helpfulness?
alice: Short instruction helpfulness (HF-rated): GPTQ ~small drop (~1), AWQ ~2-3 drop, FP8 ~0-1 but with higher variance on Mistral.
devbot: deploy-bot: snapshot created for run: snap-2026-05-04-gptq-slicewalk (artifacts: s3://redwood-evals/snap-1738001234)
eva: Latency/throughput notes? numbers pls.
alice: On p4d-equivalent: AWQ avg token latency 12ms (best), GPTQ 16ms, FP8 14ms, int8 20ms. Throughput: AWQ > FP8 > GPTQ > int8 for batched inference (seq len 512, batch 8).
frank: KV-cache drift specifics? we've had deployment regressions before.
alice: KV drift visible primarily for FP8 on long-context summarization: embeddings in cache slowly degrade after ~6k tokens causing colorless summaries. GPTQ showed consistent KV stability up to 32k. AWQ had small token-level entropy increase after 10k.
eva: Any per-model rollout recommendations?
alice: Quick rec: Llama-3-8B: GPTQ-4b recommended default; AWQ for latency-sensitive read-only workloads; FP8 for controlled batch workloads where we can monitor drift. Mistral-8x: prefer GPTQ but enable activation-folding guardrails; Qwen-7B: GPTQ for Q&A, AWQ only for low-risk UAT.
ben: Ops notes for Dedicated/Dedicated+Private?
alice: - Build canary with GPTQ-4b variant + small traffic (5%) with automatic fallback to fp16.  - Add eval hooks: daily MMLU slice + 1 long-context regression test. - KV-cache watchdog: fail traffic if avg token perplexity delta > 0.12 vs baseline.
carla: Did you observe instruction-following style regressions (hallucination increase)?
alice: Small uptick (AWQ) on persona/instruction style; GPTQ stable. Flagging to QA for targeted human evals.
frank: Anything for model-comparison dashboard?
alice: Uploading per-run csvs to the snapshot. Will add a condensed chart for latency vs delta vs throughput in the console.
devbot: ci-bot: perf-checks passed for batch-8 profiles.
eva: Thanks — please post the final rollout checklist and I'll schedule a canary next week. :thumbsup:
